text: Sam (Design): Quick design q — attaching a Figma frame: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see prompt-suite approval flow). Two UX concerns: 1) when multiple evals are selected, do we show a single ‘Approve’ action or keep per-eval CTAs? 2) tooltip help + keyboard shortcut discoverability for bulk actions. Thoughts? Elena (PM): +1 on avoiding accidental mass approvals. If we show a single action it should be gated by identical scorecard+tags. Otherwise grouped. Kofi (Frontend): Agree on gating. Also keyboard shortcuts: avoid global conflicts — maybe use Shift+Enter or Shift+A inside the review list only. We should display the hint in the tooltip: “Press Shift+A to approve selected”. Ruth (A11y): Important: tooltips must be accessible. Use role="tooltip" + aria-describedby on the approve button. For the keyboard hint make sure it's exposed to screen readers (visually hidden text). Also ensure confirmation modal is announced via aria-live and focus is moved into it. Jordi (Eng): Backend note — bulk approve should be idempotent and fast. Suggest endpoint: `POST /api/v1/evals/bulk_approve` body: `{ "ids": ["eval_1","eval_2"], "comment": "LGTM", "source": "console" }`. Return partial errors payload so UI can surface per-eval failures. Arjun (Research): We need a link to the regression diff or a sample of chosen outputs in the confirmation modal — reviewers should be able to spot-check before approving. Also audit trail: record user, time, and sample ids. Sam (Design): Microcopy options for CTA text: “Approve selected”, “Approve all”, “Bulk approve”. My vote: “Approve selected” — clearer and less scary. For confirmation modal header: “Approve X results?” body: “This will mark the selected outputs for this eval run as approved. You can undo for 10 minutes.” (undo via toast). Thoughts on wording? Elena (PM): I like “Approve selected”. Don’t promise undo permanence — maybe “You can undo from the activity log within 10 minutes.” Kofi (Frontend): For the undo toast: show anchor link “Undo” and a small spinner if backend is doing rollback. Toast should be announced with polite aria-live. Also, avoid blocking keyboard access — allow pressing Esc to close modal. Ruth (A11y): Focus trap in modal is required. When modal opens, focus first actionable element (Confirm button). On success, move focus to the toast link (or to the next item in the list). Add aria-describedby pointing to the sample diff link. Jordi (Eng): Partial failure model: if one eval fails approval due to stale version, we should return 207 Multi-Status with each id + status. UI: show inline error row with reason and a retry button for that id. Sam (Design): Small nit — the approve icon currently uses a check in a filled button. For bulk, maybe outline variant + number badge to reduce perceived severity. Arjun (Research): Also add a toggle in the modal: “Apply to all matching results in this run” (danger). Keep that collapsed by default. Elena (PM): Good call. Default to only selected, hide the “Apply to all matching” behind a disclosure with a red label and additional confirmation copy. Kofi (Frontend): Implementation note: keyboard hint should be part of the list header, not the tooltip, so it’s always discoverable: `Header: Selected 3 • Press Shift+A to approve`. Tooltip can repeat the shortcut. Sam (Design): I'll update the mock: 1) header shortcut hint, 2) small badge + outline CTA for bulk, 3) confirm modal with sample diff link and inline summary, 4) microcopy: Confirm button = “Approve selected”, Cancel = “Cancel”. Add undo toast copy: “Approval applied. Undo?”. Ruth (A11y): For the header hint include a visually-hidden label: `Press Shift A to approve selected items` and ensure it’s keyboard reachable. Also test with NVDA/VO. Jordi (Eng): I'll add the bulk endpoint and support Multi-Status by EOD. Need final list of fields for audit log: user_id, eval_ids[], action, timestamp, sample_ids[]. Sam (Design): Thanks — will update Figma and drop new frames here when ready. Scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30am to sign off before dev. @Elena can you confirm? :calendar: Elena (PM): Confirmed, added to calendar. deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled to staging at 2024-11-16 02:00 UTC for backend changes (bulk endpoint). Kofi (Frontend): One last thing — keep tooltip length short: “Approve selected (Shift+A)”. Long tooltips break on small screens. Sam (Design): Good call. I'll keep it short. Thanks everyone — will post updated mock + copy in this thread shortly :thumbsup:
